frozen_before_tuning: Fixtures, sizes, seeds, gates and clocks are fixed in this file before any timing or candidate tuning. Changing any field creates a new suite version; old receipts keep their version.

frozen_compiler.identity_note: research/latch_ops/ops is byte-identical between integrated production checkpoint 96742fdfe and ab4703ee3, so LATCH-P9 measurements of 96742fd apply to this compiler pin.

optimizer.note: Same coupled-decay momentum SGD as the legacy regression capture (research/latch_ops/jobs.py cpu_case).

mlp_programs.source: research/latch_ops/examples/models.py (Case, parameters, fixture, make_loss); untied=True is the existing oracle form of make_loss, here compiled as a straight chain of distinct matrices

heldout-128.note: existing reserved composition CASES['heldout']; native correctness previously checked, never timed

ordinary-101.7m.description: released ~101.7M byte transformer B4/T512/D1024/H16/L8, SGD lr .01 momentum .9 wd 1e-4
ordinary-101.7m.native: native-practical (precision_policy practical, BF16 operands, FP32 master)

recurrent-29m.description: shared four-block recurrent transformer B4/T512/D768/H12, runtime count 3, aux 0.25, dropout 0.1

recurrent-near100m.description: B4/T512/D1024/H16, eight shared blocks, count 3, fresh states only

transformer_programs.heldout_note: Untuned LATCH-P9 transfers. Their frozen-compiler timings already exist and are reused, not rerun; only a candidate comparison reruns them (paired with the frozen build).

moe_programs.status: deferred until /private/tmp/megakernel-fgm-byte/research/fgm_byte/HANDOFF_NUMERICS.md records a frozen checkpoint
moe_programs.rule: Native timings stay diagnostic while the native parameter gate fails; failed verdicts are preserved. No MoE training campaign.

mlp_numerics.reference: independent CPU FP32 eager autograd + torch.optim.SGD at the identical saved state (validation.eager_step), computed in the CPU build task
mlp_numerics.scope: same-state numerical agreement only; it does not imply learning quality or speed

mlp_learning.schedule: cycle fixture(case, step=s % 8) for s in 0..399; evaluate mean FP32 eager loss over the same 8-batch pool
mlp_learning.scope: optimization-progress check on fixed synthetic fixtures (labels are random), not generalization or data efficiency; it decides practical eligibility of reduced-precision controls

mlp_timing.clock: CUDA events around N back-to-back CUDA-graph replays of the complete changing-state update (forward, loss, backward, SGD momentum/decay, parameter/momentum writes); resident inputs; median of samples per round; median of round medians
mlp_timing.order: arm order rotates each round; each arm is a fresh process

arms.native: frozen or pinned compiler, FP32 capture, one cooperative generated kernel
arms.eager_sgd_graph: PyTorch loss + autograd + torch.optim.SGD(foreach) captured in one CUDA graph, FP32
arms.fx_graph: captured derivative FX graph + ATen/cuBLAS + functional SGD captured in one CUDA graph, FP32
arms.compiled_fp32: torch.compile(fullgraph, max-autotune-no-cudagraphs) loss/backward + compiled SGD step, captured in one CUDA graph, FP32
arms.compiled_bf16: same as compiled_fp32 under torch.autocast(bfloat16); FP32 master parameters and momentum

mlp_timing.selection: strongest valid control = fastest arm passing its strict numerical gate, plus separately the fastest arm passing the learning gate (practical); a failed gate makes a timing diagnostic only
mlp_timing.precision: TF32 disabled; float32 matmul precision highest

profile.method: existing CTA0 post-barrier %globaltimer stamps (Runtime.profile_step) plus an optional instrumented copy of the generated source that accumulates each CTA's time inside every grid barrier
profile.validation: instrumented binary must give bitwise-identical state to the uninstrumented build; overhead = instrumented (profile off/on) vs uninstrumented complete-update time
profile.scope: diagnostic attribution; not used for speed claims; suspected bottlenecks are labelled as such unless measured here
